600	ואז שמואל הנביא דיבר עם שאול דרך בעלת האוב.	Then Shmuel the prophet spoke with Shaul through the medium.	Então o profeta Shmuel falou com Shaul por meio da necromante.
601	והוא שאל אותו, מה יקרה לי?	And he asked him, what will happen to me?	E ele lhe perguntou: o que vai acontecer comigo?
602	מה יהיה?	What will be?	O que vai ser?
603	לצאת למלחמה, לא לצאת.	Go out to war, or not go out.	Sair para a guerra ou não sair?
604	אמר לו שמואל, מחר אתה אימי.	Shmuel said to him, tomorrow you will be with me.	Shmuel lhe disse: amanhã você estará comigo.
605	דרשה הגמרא ברכות בדף י"ב, אימי במחיצתי.	The Gemara in Berachot, page 12, expounds: "with me" — in my company.	A Guemará em Berachot, página 12, explica: "comigo" — na minha companhia.
606	זאת אומרת, הוא בישר אותו שמחר הוא הולך למות.	That is, he informed him that tomorrow he is going to die.	Ou seja, anunciou-lhe que amanhã ele iria morrer.
607	הוא בישר אותו שמחר הוא הולך למות.	He informed him that tomorrow he is going to die.	Anunciou-lhe que amanhã ele iria morrer.
608	אז הוא אמר, אם אני בלאו הכי הולך למות, אז אני אצא כבר למלחמה.	So he said, if I am going to die anyway, then I will go out to war.	Então ele disse: se de qualquer forma vou morrer, então vou sair para a guerra.
609	לפחות אני אהרוג פלישתים, אצא למלחמה, ואז	At least I will kill Philistines, I will go out to war, and then	Pelo menos matarei filisteus, sairei para a guerra, e então
610	שאול מבין שהוא הולך למות מחר כי ככה אמר לו שמואל	Shaul understands that he is going to die tomorrow, because that is what Shmuel told him,	Shaul entende que vai morrer amanhã, porque foi isso que Shmuel lhe disse,
611	ולכן ההיתר, ככה מבאר הרד"ק, גאוני, ההיתר של שאול	and therefore the permission — so the Radak explains, brilliant — the permission of Shaul	e por isso a permissão — assim explica o Radak, genial — a permissão de Shaul
612	להתאבד, כי בלאו הכי הוא ידע שהפלישתים יהרגו אותו, כי שמואל אמר לו	to take his own life, is because anyway he knew the Philistines would kill him, since Shmuel told him	para se matar, é porque de qualquer forma ele sabia que os filisteus o matariam, pois Shmuel lhe disse
613	אתמול שמחר אתה אימי, עמי במחיצתי, אתה בלאו הכי הולך למות מחר.	yesterday that tomorrow you will be with me, in my company; you are going to die tomorrow anyway.	ontem que amanhã você estará comigo, na minha companhia; de qualquer forma você vai morrer amanhã.
614	אז כיוון ששאול ידע שהוא הולך למות, מה זה משנה אם הם יהרגו אותי או אני אהרוג את עצמי? עדיף	So since Shaul knew he was going to die, what difference does it make if they kill me or I kill myself? Better	Então, como Shaul sabia que ia morrer, que diferença faz se eles me matarem ou eu me matar? É melhor
615	שאני אהרוג את עצמי, והם לא יתעללו בי ויהרגו אותי. ולכן הוא הרג את עצמו, וזה ההיתר שאומר	that I kill myself, so they do not abuse me and then kill me. And so he killed himself, and this is the permission that	que eu me mate, para que não abusem de mim e depois me matem. E por isso ele se matou, e essa é a permissão que
616	המדרש: יכול כשאול? תלמוד לומר "אך". למדנו מכאן שההיתר של	the Midrash states: One might think, like Shaul? The verse says "ach." We learn from here that the permission of	o Midrash diz: poderia ser como Shaul? Diz o versículo "ach". Aprendemos daqui que a permissão de
617	שאול היה היתר צדדי, חד פעמי, חריג. שאיך	Shaul was a side permission, one-time, exceptional. For how	Shaul foi uma permissão lateral, única, excepcional. Pois como
618	היה מותר לשאול לרצוח את עצמו?	was Shaul permitted to murder himself?	era permitido a Shaul assassinar a si mesmo?
619	למה?	Why?	Por quê?
620	כי הוא ידע מהסיאנס שהוא הולך למות.	Because he knew from the séance that he was going to die.	Porque ele soube pela sessão espírita que ia morrer.
621	הבנתם את הפירוש של הרד"ק?	Did you understand the Radak's explanation?	Vocês entenderam a explicação do Radak?
622	הבנתם את זה?	Did you understand it?	Entenderam isso?
623	זה מבריק.	It is brilliant.	É genial.
624	לא יודע אם אתם צוהלים בפנים ורק הפרצוף שלכם לא צוהל, או לא יודע איך זה עובד אצלכם.	I do not know if you are rejoicing inside and only your face is not, or how it works with you.	Não sei se vocês estão exultando por dentro e só o rosto não demonstra, ou como isso funciona com vocês.
625	מה יותר יפה מזה?	What is more beautiful than this?	O que é mais bonito do que isso?
626	זה מבריק.	It is brilliant.	É genial.
627	אני מתקשה בזה.	I have a difficulty with this.	Eu tenho uma dificuldade nisso.
628	מישהו רוצה להקשות לי?	Does anyone want to challenge me?	Alguém quer me fazer uma objeção?
629	למה זה קשה?	Why is it difficult?	Por que é difícil?
630	הוא עושה את זה באיסור.	He is doing it in violation of a prohibition.	Ele faz isso transgredindo uma proibição.
631	לא, למה?	No, why?	Não, por quê?
632	הוא ידע שהוא הולך למות.	He knew that he was going to die.	Ele sabia que ia morrer.
633	אני שואל, איך הוא ידע מתי הוא הולך למות?	I ask, how did he know when he was going to die?	Eu pergunto: como ele sabia quando ia morrer?
634	אמרו לו "למחר אתה עמי", עמי במחיצתי.	They told him "tomorrow you will be with me," with me in my company.	Disseram-lhe "amanhã você estará comigo", comigo na minha companhia.
635	אולי מדובר פה שזה היה דקה לפני צאת הכוכבים.	Perhaps this was a minute before nightfall.	Talvez isso tenha sido um minuto antes de sair as estrelas.
636	וכבר אם יהיה צאת הכוכבים, זה כבר לא למחר.	And once nightfall comes, it is no longer tomorrow.	E quando as estrelas saírem, já não é amanhã.
637	זאת אומרת, הוא יודע שנשאר לו רק דקה אחת לחיות.	That is, he knows he has only one minute left to live.	Ou seja, ele sabe que lhe resta apenas um minuto de vida.
638	אז אם זה ככה, אז זה בסדר שהוא הרג את עצמו? כי הם היו הורגים אותו, כי שמואל כבר אמר לו,	So if that is so, then it is fine that he killed himself? Because they would have killed him, since Shmuel had already told him,	Então, se é assim, está tudo bem ele ter se matado? Porque eles o matariam, já que Shmuel já lhe tinha dito:
639	למחר אתה עמי.	tomorrow you will be with me.	amanhã você estará comigo.
